display_information.name: RAG Bot
display_information.description: Your go-to helper bot for questions about <YOUR_DOMAIN>.
display_information.long_description:
RAG Bot - AI-Powered Q&A Assistant

RAG Bot is an intelligent Slack bot that provides instant, accurate answers to questions about <YOUR_DOMAIN>. It helps your team quickly find information without leaving Slack.

Key Features:
- Instant Knowledge Access - Get immediate answers based on your team's documentation and verified Slack discussions
- Smart Document Search - AI retrieval over your help center articles, internal docs, and Slack Q&A threads
- Always Up-to-Date - Re-ingest from source whenever your content changes; verified answers are marked with the :verified: reaction
- Secure & Internal - Only accesses the sources you've ingested - never browses external websites

How It Works:
Ask RAG Bot a question in the configured Slack channel. The bot uses RAG (retrieval-augmented generation) over:
- Your structured documentation (help center, wiki, markdown)
- Verified Slack Q&A threads from your team
- Whatever other text sources you ingest

Perfect For:
- New team members getting up to speed
- Support teams needing fast access to canonical answers
- Reducing repetitive questions and keeping experts focused

Privacy & Security:
RAG Bot operates exclusively on the internal sources you've ingested. Responses are grounded in retrieved context, with citations to the source material.

Customize this manifest before submitting:
- Change `name` and `display_name` to your bot's name (paired with BOT_NAME in .env)
- Update `description` and `long_description` for your domain
- Set `request_url` to your n8n webhook URL after importing the workflow
- The two bot scopes below are the minimum — don't widen them unless your workflow actually needs more
